images.caption: in the ArbetSam database.

Utö kyrka (church). Utö island, Haninge Municipality, Stockholm archipelago. The church belongs to Dalarö-Ornö-Utö Parish, Church of Sweden. The church was built in 1849-50, architect Johan Fredrik Åbom. The church was financed by the Utö Grufwebolag (Utö mining company).
